title: The Outlaw's Telephobia
narrative_script: Anomaly Log 007. The Subject is a Wild West Gunslinger, currently staring at a smartphone, paralyzed by making a live phone call. Biometrics indicate severe [anxiety].
Vocal cords show severe atrophy. They survived high-noon duels, but their nervous system is being [weaponized] by a glowing rectangle.
Ancient biology is entirely incompatible with [weaponized] Silicon Valley code. The Subject is performing unpaid data entry for an [algorithm].
Willpower cannot defeat a supercomputer. A structural [override] is required.
To quarantine the code and restore historical dopamine baselines, the Extraction [Protocol] is in the bio.
